caption: The drawing depicts a single dress that occupies the majority of the composition, centered on a plain, light-colored background. The dress features a full, floor-length skirt with dense pleating that radiates outward from a cinched waist. The bodice is fitted and slightly gathered towards the waist, and the neckline is wide and subtly scooped. The sleeves are short, reaching just below the elbow, and are finished with transparent, ruffled lace at the ends. The main fabric of the dress appears light gray or pale green and is detailed with fine, repeated text or lines in black, with occasional red marks interspersed throughout the text, creating a textured pattern across the entire garment. There are no other objects or figures in the drawing. In the bottom left corner, there is the name "Nancy Crimi" written in small, neat script.
title: Dress
